title: ID0422515-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R4 170001760] Technical Error
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
On-site, I discovered that an internal short circuit had apparently
occurred inside one of the 20kW power modules -TB10, and the
AC-side wiring harness supplying the power module was also
damaged. I removed the broken power module, the wiring harness
supplying the module, and the DC-side wiring harness from the
module to prevent further damage. I had two spare modules with
me, but no wiring harnesses. Wiring harnesses have not failed
before, so I did not anticipate a broken wiring harness.
As a result of the failure, the surrounding area was also covered
with “electrical” soot and some copper splashes. I tried to remove
the excess dirt as best as I could. Also surrounding power
converters were cleaned with pressurized air.

additional_info.subject: AW: ID0422515-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R4 170001760] Technical Error CRM:02679000227
additional_info.body:
Hello Francisco,
the following message we got from Daimler and the message from the finnish technician
Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,
Bei unseren Wintertests in Finnland kam es zu einem Defekt einer unserer SiCharge D Ladestationen (MP / R4 170001760).
Ein Siemens Techniker aus Finnland hat die Ladestation vor Ort repariert.
hier die Fehlerbeschreibung und Maßnahmen des Technikers:
"On-site, I discovered that an internal short circuit had apparently occurred inside one of the 20kW power modules -TB10, and the AC-side wiring harness supplying the power module was also damaged. I removed the broken power module, the wiring harness supplying the module, and the DC-side wiring harness from the module to prevent further damage. I had two spare modules with me, but no wiring harnesses. Wiring harnesses have not failed before, so I did not anticipate a broken wiring harness.
As a result of the failure, the surrounding area was also covered with “electrical” soot and some copper splashes. I tried to remove the excess dirt as best as I could. Also surrounding power converters were cleaned with pressurized air.
I managed to restore the charger to operation at 280kW power. Both plugs were tested, and the right plug was also successfully used to charge an electric truck at higher power. If wanted to restore the charger back to 300kW power, the power module and wiring harnesses need to be installed."
Derzeit können wir mit der Ladestation also mit 280 kW laden.
Wie können wir veranlassen, dass das fehlende 20 kW Power-Modul beim Charger MP / R4 170001760 ersetzt wird?
Vielen Dank.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
